NeoCell GROW

Keep it on the seed.
Keep it in suspension.

NeoCell GROW is being developed around the physical challenges of agricultural formulations.

Request Sample ↗

Agricultural formulations face physical challenges before they ever reach the field. Particles settle. Seed coatings can distribute unevenly. Applied material can fail to remain where it is needed.

Benefits

Suspension

Support dispersed ingredients and evaluate the tendency of solids to separate during storage or handling.

Coating structure

Evaluate pickup, coating uniformity and physical structure on treated seeds or surfaces.

Adhesion & film formation

Explore how fibrillated cellulose networks can support material retention after application.

Application flow

Shear-thinning behaviour can make structured systems easier to mix, pump and apply.

Applications

Seed coatings

Coating, adhesion and material-retention evaluation

Suspension concentrates

Physical structure and suspension

Liquid fertilisers

Flow and carrier functionality

Biological formulations

Carrier-system evaluation

Crop protection

Formulation development
